what_is_wrong: page rotated 4 degrees, grey background noise, no text layer
reason: OCR on a skewed noisy scan is unsure of at least one key field; the app holds rather than guess

what_is_wrong: 100 dpi, 1-bit black and white, salt-and-pepper speckles
reason: worst-case OCR; fields that cannot be read confidently go to a person

what_is_wrong: dark blob covers the CGST/SGST rows; grand total readable
reason: tax lines are obscured, so the invoice cannot be proved to agree with itself

what_is_wrong: 'RECEIVED' stamp and a pen scribble cross the total line
reason: ink crosses the grand total, so the total is not reliably readable

what_is_wrong: items drawn as side-by-side cards, labels to the right of values
reason: digital text layer and a real PO match; only the arrangement is new

what_is_wrong: 'Bill No.', 'Document Date', 'Tax Inv. Ref' instead of the usual words
reason: the values are all present and the maths holds; only the label wording differs

what_is_wrong: '04-Nov-26', '4/12/2026' and 'November 4th 2026' on one page
reason: all three are unambiguous; the parser should normalise them

what_is_wrong: lakh-style commas with 'Rs.' prefixes instead of a bare number
reason: Indian digit grouping and an 'Rs.' prefix are both ordinary

what_is_wrong: the grand total also written out as words underneath
reason: the words agree with the figure; extra text should not confuse the reader

what_is_wrong: a '-0.40' round-off makes subtotal + tax differ from the total
reason: 0.40 is inside the 1 rupee rounding tolerance, and the round-off line explains it

what_is_wrong: quantities set in a handwriting font
reason: still a digital text layer, so the characters are exact even though they look handwritten

what_is_wrong: line items continue on page 2 and the totals are only on page 2
reason: all pages of a digital PDF are read (up to 5), so the lines on page 2 and the totals are found and add up

what_is_wrong: no separate tax column; GST is already inside the prices
reason: the note states the rate, so the tax can be backed out of the total

what_is_wrong: a single IGST line instead of the usual CGST/SGST pair
reason: the vendor is in Karnataka and we are in Tamil Nadu, so IGST is the correct tax

what_is_wrong: no PO field; the order is mentioned as 'your order 2026/0106'
reason: a PO the app had to infer is never auto-approved, by design

what_is_wrong: line 1: quantity x rate does not equal the printed amount
reason: a digital PDF is never repaired - a broken identity there is the vendor's error

what_is_wrong: GSTIN printed as O7ABEFS2207MIZ4 (O for 0, I for 1)
reason: the 'O' sits in a digit-only position and is repaired, but the 'I' sits in the entity-code position where a letter is also legal, so the checksum cannot prove a repair and a person is asked

what_is_wrong: re-bills INV-0042 as 'INV - 0042 / A', same date and amount
reason: the '/A' suffix defeats the exact-number check, so only the amount+date fallback catches it as a possible duplicate

what_is_wrong: every label given in Hindi and English together
reason: digital text layer; the English half of each label is enough to find the fields

what_is_wrong: perspective tilt, uneven lighting, shadow in the bottom-right corner
reason: a photo is the hardest input; unreadable fields go to a person rather than being guessed
